name: Shellmound Campground
note: Privately run campground on TVA land at the Shellmound Recreation Area on Nickajack Lake, beside TVA's day-use area, boat ramp and swim beach. First-come-first-served with no online booking: call the office the same day and it will hold a site. Many sites are held by seasonal and long-term campers. No website of its own; the operator posts on Facebook. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Google Maps 'Shellmound Campground', 2735 TVA Rd, Jasper (read 2026-11-25 via gm.py): open, phone 423-942-9857, 4.6 on 382 reviews, at the pin -> presence passes; RV Life park 15217 (read 2026-11-25): 4.5 stars on 17 reviews, price tier $$ (avg_rate $35, last_rate $40), 50-amp electric + water, pull-throughs, dump; RV Life reviews (api/reviews/park/15217) show one-night motorhome and fifth-wheel stays sold by the night at $40 (Apr 2026), $41 (Oct 2025, site 37 pull-through), $40 (May 2025, site 37, 50 A), $50 (Jul 2024, site 45) -> cheapest real RV night ~$40, under the US$50 gate (gateways.py: none within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park in trip_data/goodsam_parks.json). Facebook page (read 2026-11-25) active, post of 2026-10-06. Long-stay: reviews 2020-2024 mention many seasonal/long-term campers ('Lots of campers there pick a site for whole season', 2021; 'Most were permanent spots', Aug 2024), but a 2016-01-11 Esri Wayback frame shows the shore loop's pads mostly empty off-season (about 16 units packed in the north field), and nightly sites at 37, 45, 46/47, 14, 17, 21, 27, 35, 36, 44 appear in 2021-2026 reviews; no site count to measure the share (Campendium 47, RV Life 50 sites), no lease/application/minimum found. Duplicate check: no entry by name; nearest entry 4492 Marion County Park 4.9 km.
waterfront_evidence: Nickajack Lake (Tennessee River), read 2026-11-25. Esri World Imagery (current leaf-on, z19) and Esri Wayback 2016-01-11 leaf-off at 35.0075,-85.6090: the shore row of the RV loop sits on the south side of the campground road about 35-50 m from the shoreline, with a continuous wooded bank band along the whole frontage; no open apron to the water. 3DEP lidar N-S transects at -85.6110/-85.6095/-85.6075: pads 199-203 m, lidar water surface 192.8 m (Nickajack normal pool 632-635 ft), the bank dropping 6-9 m over the last 20-30 m -> fails the kayak test (pads far more than 1-2 m above the edge). Nickajack Dam lies about 1 km WSW; the campground is on the reservoir side. Reviews call sites 17/21/27/35/37 'on the water' or 'water view', but reviews are not a basis and no official or dated photo was found showing a lake view from an RV site, so no lakeview either -> default down to not waterfront.

fees.note: Camper-reported: $40 a night in April 2026 and May 2025, $41 in October 2025 (RV Life reviews); the operator posts no rate.

fees_source: https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/15217 (RV Life reviews, read 2026-11-25): 'stayed 4/2026 | price $40 USD a night | Motorhome'; 'stayed 10/2025 | price $41 USD a night | Motorhome | site 37 pull_through'; 'stayed 5/2025 | price $40 USD a night | Fifth Wheel | site 37 pull_through | 50 amp Pull through on a lake for $40'; earlier 'stayed 7/2024 | price $50 USD a night | Motorhome | site 45'. Campendium lists the last reported nightly rate as $35.
hookups_source: RV Life reviews (api/reviews/park/15217, read 2026-11-25): 5/2025 site 37 '50 amp Pull through', 'power 1 water yes'; 7/2024 site 45 and 8/2024 sites 46/47 'water yes sewer no'; RV Life park record cg_50amp yes, cg_water yes, cg_full_hookup no. Sewer left out: one 10/2025 review says sewer yes at site 37, the others and a 2022 Campendium review ('Water, power, no sewer but there is a dump site here') say no.
facilities_source: RV Life park 15217 record (read 2026-11-25): cg_showers yes, cg_restrooms yes, cg_water yes, cg_dump_station yes; Campendium/The Dyrt review Sep 2022 site 17: 'no sewer but there is a dump site here'; The Dyrt review Aug 2019: 'Only one shower per bathroom'.
flags: Long-stay test 2: the park has no website of its own and no booking engine (Facebook only, first-come), and reviews describe many seasonal/long-term campers. I read it as a traveller campground with a seasonal share (one-night stays readily sold 2024-2026, shore loop mostly empty in the 2016 off-season frame), so test 2's 'posted nightly rate or booking site' was not applied; if the reviewer reads it as mostly long-stay, it fails test 2 and is a drop. The nightly share is unmeasured (no site count from the operator).

Price is camper-reported only (RV Life reviews, dated 2025-2026); no operator-posted rate exists. Peak seen: $50 a night in July 2024 (site 45), exactly at the gate. An Aug 2024 reviewer paid $33 with a 'Good Sam' discount, but the park is not a Good Sam Park in the directory cache.
Ownership: on TVA land (Shellmound Recreation Area) but run by a private family operator, not Go Camp Tennessee; stored private.

Facebook post 2026-10-06 calls the trunk-or-treat 'our last trunk-or-treating @ Shellmound Campground' - most likely the last of the season, but it could hint at a closure or change of operator; no news of either found.

Season left out: reviews from 2020-2026 are dated in every month of the year (winter stays in Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar), but listings disagree (The Dyrt: Feb 1-Jan 15; another Dyrt page: mid-April-Oct 30) and the operator publishes none.
Waterfront: reviews call some sites waterfront/water-view; a dated photo from an RV site showing the lake could earn lakeview (wooded bank, pads 6-9 m above the water).
why: Long-stay test 2 (reviewer call 2026-11-25, 'on the fence = drop', AWH 2026-10-31): campers describe many seasonal/long-term sites (Aug 2024 RV Life review: 'Most were permanent spots'), the nightly share is unmeasured, and a mostly long-stay park must sell nights through a nightly rate on its own site + phone or a booking site. Shellmound has neither: no website, no posted rate (only camper-reported $40-41), Facebook only, first-come with a same-day phone hold. Google 4.6/382, RV Life 4.5*/$$; otherwise it would have passed.
